images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER, direction S; use it for exact identity, costume, proportions, rest pose and painted register. Create exactly ONE full-body turnaround illustration on a portrait canvas matching Image 1, same standing height and framing, feet fully visible, centered. Rotate this SAME young woman to face NW, toward the viewer's UPPER-LEFT, 135 degrees away from the S pose: BACK THREE-QUARTER VIEW, her BACK and LEFT side visible, LEFT side nearest the camera. Her head faces AWAY upper-left; NO FACE VISIBLE. The olive satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip must be SCREEN-LEFT nearest the camera. Her anatomical RIGHT arm and upright plain walnut staff must be on the FAR side, SCREEN-RIGHT behind her, staff tip visible above the far shoulder. The single diagonal harness passes over her anatomical RIGHT shoulder to her LEFT hip. Do not mirror. Keep anatomical item ownership exact. Same even-weight standing rest pose, arms relaxed with right hand gripping the upright staff. Same dark curly tied-back hair mass, sun-browned skin, early-20s woman, ivory linen shirt, navy sleeveless long split tabard, navy trousers, chestnut laced bracers, chestnut buckled boots, ONE chestnut diagonal harness, ONE waist belt, ONE olive canvas satchel at left hip. Plain dark walnut staff with small brass ferrules at foot and tip; no head-piece or ring. Every surface plain, no insignia or emblems, no extra objects. Camera stays fixed: elevated three-quarter pinhole view approximately 53 degrees above ground plane, character rotates only. Single key light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, fixed in screen space, slight rim on key-facing silhouette, deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black. No spell glow, no warm or saturated light sources. NO floor shadow. High-resolution painted 2D illustration, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouette, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Blue, ivory and brass palette with the master's chestnut leather. Entire background flat uniform pure #00ff00 to canvas edges, no gradients, no transparency, no checkerboard, no scenery, do not matte. This task requests one portrait master matching the reference, not a sheet or registered square sprite.
